etymologies.etymologyHTML: Borrowed from Latin nōminātus, perfect passive participle of nōminō (“I name”), from nōmen (“a name”).

definitions.definition: To name someone as a candidate for a particular role or position, including that of an office.
(cue sports) To specify in advance which pocket a ball will be potted in; to call; to name.
(obsolete) To entitle, confer a name upon.
